name: io.hibira/mcp-approval-gate
title: Approval gate for databases
description: Wraps a database MCP server: reads pass, writes wait for a supervisor to approve them.

environmentVariables.name: GATE_COMMAND
environmentVariables.description: The database MCP server to wrap, e.g. npx -y @bytebase/dbhub --transport stdio --dsn postgres://user:pass@host/db

environmentVariables.name: GATE_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: The database's name on the approval page

environmentVariables.name: GATE_PUSH_INTERESTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated push interests that receive approval requests
